title: The Part Library page refuses a number that another entry already has
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin who can pick two locations in the location selector, {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) and {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBDUP-01) is stocked at {Location-A} only.
  • Part Library entry {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBDUP-02, all capitals, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib dup B") is a separate entry, stocked at {Location-B} only.
  • {Number-A} is {Part-B} typed in lower case (for example zzautotest-pl-libdup-02).
custom_steps:
1. Pick {Location-A} in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  3. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the {Part-A} row.
  5. Click the edit icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  6. Replace the Part Number with {Part-B}, exactly as it is, with the same capitals.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Wait 5 seconds.
  9. Replace the Part Number with {Number-A}.
  10. Click Save.
  11. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  12. Type {Number-A} in the Search box.
  13. Replace the search text with {Part-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: The save is refused and the Edit Library Part dialog stays open. A red error toast reads "Part number {Part-B} already belongs to another part in the Part Library." with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."
  • Step 8: The toast has closed on its own after about 3 seconds, and the dialog is still open.
  • Step 10: The save goes through, because {Number-A} is not exactly the same as {Part-B} (upper and lower case differ): the detail page shows {Number-A} exactly as typed.
  • Step 12: The renamed entry is listed with {Number-A}, carrying the description of {Part-A}'s entry.
  • Step 13: {Part-B} is still listed as its own entry, with its own description (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib dup B"): the two entries were not merged.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S11-R3a, S13-N1, §4 Key Decisions, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Confluence comment 924876801 (Chris Ward, 7 Oct 2026, decision 2). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-N1: “If another Part Library entry already has exactly the typed number, with the same characters and the same upper and lower case, the save is refused, the dialog stays open, and the system shows "Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library."”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (A rename follows the same match rule as linking): “A rename follows the same match rule as linking. A rename is refused only when another Part Library entry has exactly the typed number: the same characters, with the same upper and lower case.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part number already belongs to another entry): “"Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (context note): “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
  • S12-R3: “The dialog for editing a Part Library entry is titled "Edit Library Part".”
